products.name: Endpoint Health & Digital Experience Monitoring — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up endpoint health and digital experience monitoring with Intune Endpoint analytics (plus an optional DEX platform path) — startup, reliability, and resource scores that surface degradations before users call. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See how every endpoint actually performs — before users call the help desk

Most endpoint problems are invisible until a user complains: slow boots, app crashes, failing disks, battery wear, devices that never restart. By then the damage to productivity (and, in a clinical setting, to care) is done. This solution stands up endpoint health and digital experience monitoring using Microsoft Intune Endpoint analytics — startup performance, application reliability, resource and recommended-software scores — with an optional path to a dedicated digital-experience platform (such as Nexthink or Tanium) where deeper telemetry is required, so you find and fix degradations proactively.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what endpoint health and digital experience monitoring is, the Intune Endpoint analytics model (startup, app reliability, work-from-anywhere, resource performance), proactive remediation, and where a dedicated DEX platform fits.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Endpoint analytics enablement, device data collection, optional DEX platform licensing, a baseline period) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Vendor-specific DEX setup is deferred to the vendor's documentation.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable Endpoint analytics, onboard devices, set baselines, interpret scores, wire proactive remediations for common issues, optionally integrate a DEX platform, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — monitoring-readiness discovery, device health/data-collection validation, a fleet health-score and issues report, safe remediation of common degradations, and a monitoring-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Proactive visibility into how every endpoint really performs — startup, reliability, and resource health scored and trending, common issues remediated automatically — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EHEM-Discovery.ps1 — endpoint health monitoring readiness and current posture (read-only)
    • EHEM-Remediation.ps1 — safely remediate common endpoint-health degradations (default -WhatIf)
    • EHEM-Report.ps1 — fleet Endpoint analytics scores + top issues via Microsoft Graph (read-only)
    • EHEM-Set-MonitoringScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/update the monitoring-scope Entra group (Graph)
    • EHEM-Validation.ps1 — confirm this device is ready to report to Intune Endpoint analytics (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
